home.title: Software Products and Platforms
home.description: CODEX TECH builds its own software products, and builds the platforms, apps and AI solutions that companies and organisations need.
home.headline: We turn ideas into *digital* products
home.subheading: We build scalable, secure, and intelligent digital solutions that empower businesses to grow, automate, and lead.

intro.lineThree: A product solves a real problem.
intro.support: That sequence is the whole company. We are engineers who ship — our own products first, then the platforms our clients run their business on.

productsSection.headline: Two products we build, own and *operate*.
productsSection.lead: We do not hand software over and walk away. We run our own platforms in production, which is why we know what it takes to keep software alive.

servicesSection.headline: From architecture to *production*.
servicesSection.lead: Six capabilities that arrive as one system rather than six separate services.

processSection.headline: Four steps, and no surprises.
processSection.lead: The same sequence on every project, whether it runs for six weeks or two years.

company.headline: A software company with its own *products*.
company.bodyOne: CODEX TECH designs and engineers platforms, applications and AI systems — and builds products of its own. Owning products is the part that keeps us honest about maintenance, uptime and the real cost of a shortcut.
company.bodyTwo: We work in Arabic and English, right to left and left to right, with the same care given to both.

closing.headline: Tell us what you are *building*.
closing.body: Send the outline of the idea. You will get a straight answer about scope, sequence and what it takes to run it.

webPlatforms.name: Web platforms
webPlatforms.summary: Dashboards, portals and internal systems built to carry real operations.
webPlatforms.detail: The system a team actually works in all day: roles and permissions, records and approvals, search that returns the right row, and an interface that stays fast once the data is no longer a demo.

includes.c: A permission for every employee and a record of every change
includes.d: Stays fast however large the data grows

aiSolutions.name: AI solutions
aiSolutions.summary: Assistants, document intelligence and automation that fit how the team already works.
aiSolutions.detail: AI applied to a specific job rather than bolted on as a feature: reading documents, answering from your own content, classifying what arrives, and drafting the work a person then approves.

includes.a: An assistant that answers from your company's own data
includes.d: A person reviews and approves before anything is acted on

mobileApps.name: Mobile apps
mobileApps.summary: iPhone and Android apps that work on the same data as your web system.
mobileApps.detail: One product, two screens: the phone app and the web system read the same data, so a change shows up in both at the same moment.

includes.a: One app that works on iPhone and Android

dataAnalytics.name: Data & analytics
dataAnalytics.summary: Your scattered data gathered into clear reports you can decide from.
dataAnalytics.detail: Getting data out of the systems it is trapped in, agreeing on what each number means, and putting it somewhere a decision can be made from without exporting a spreadsheet first.

includes.a: Data gathered from your systems and kept up to date automatically
includes.c: One agreed number for every measure

automation.name: Automation
automation.summary: Manual steps replaced by workflows that run without being asked.
automation.detail: The repeated work between systems — copying, chasing, checking, notifying — described once as a workflow and then left to run, with a record of what happened and what failed.

includes.b: Tasks that run on time, or when something specific happens
includes.d: An instant alert if something breaks, and a record of what happened

integrations.name: Integrations
integrations.summary: The payment, accounting and messaging systems you already use, working together.
integrations.detail: Connecting what you already pay for. One integration layer with its own error handling, so a third-party outage is a queued job rather than a broken page.

includes.d: Automatic, secure data exchange between systems

accreditation.name: Codex Accreditation
accreditation.summary: Accreditation and access control for conferences, exhibitions and large events — registration, badges, on-site verification and permissions in one system.
accreditation.detail: Everyone who attends an event needs a credential, and every credential is a decision: who approved it, where it grants access, and whether it is still valid at the gate. The platform holds that decision from the first registration form to the moment a badge is scanned.
accreditation.audience: Built for event organisers, exhibition operators and the teams running accreditation on the day.

daawa.name: Lammetna
daawa.summary: Digital invitations from design to the door: design the invitation, send it to your list, see who is coming, and check guests in on the day.
daawa.detail: Sending the invitation is the easy part. The hard part is knowing who received it, who answered, who actually came, and keeping the list right as it changes up to the last minute. Lammetna keeps the invitation, the guest list and the door in one place.
daawa.audience: For hosts, event planners and agencies that run invitations for their clients.

features.a: Design the invitation in your own style
features.b: Send to everyone at once, with automatic reminders
features.c: Follow the replies as they come in
features.d: Check guests in at the door from a phone
features.e: One guest list, always up to date

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: How engagements with CODEX TECH are scoped and priced.
pricing.headline: Starting prices are public. The final one is scoped.
pricing.lead: Software is not a subscription tier, so we do not price it like one. The figures here are the floor for the smallest serious version of each service; the real number comes from a written scope you see in full before anything starts.
pricing.servicesNote: These are floors, not quotes: the cost of the smallest version of each service we are willing to deliver. They rise with the size of the system, the number of integrations, and what uptime and security the work demands.

project.name: Fixed-scope project
project.suits: A defined system with a clear outcome and a delivery date.
project.note: Priced against a written scope after discovery, invoiced in phases tied to delivery.

retainer.name: Monthly retainer
retainer.suits: A live product that keeps evolving after launch.
retainer.note: A reserved capacity each month for development, maintenance and support.

partnership.name: Product partnership
partnership.suits: A product built jointly, where we carry part of the build.
partnership.note: Structured case by case, with a written agreement covering ownership and terms.

factors.a: How much of the system already exists
factors.b: The number of user roles and workflows
factors.c: Integrations with systems you already run
factors.d: Data volume, uptime and security requirements

pricing.note: Discovery is a paid, short first phase on larger projects. It produces the scope, the architecture and the estimate — and it is yours whether or not you continue with us.

cta.headline: Get a scoped estimate.
cta.body: Send what you have — a document, a sketch, or a paragraph. We will come back with scope, sequence and a number.

pricing.quoteNote: starting prices · final price after we agree the scope

about.title: Company
about.description: CODEX TECH builds its own software products, and builds the platforms, apps and AI solutions that companies and organisations need.
about.headline: A software company with its own products.
about.lead: We build software products — our own, and the systems other organisations run their business on.

story.one: CODEX TECH is a software company. We design and build platforms, apps and AI solutions, and we run two products of our own, Codex Accreditation and Lammetna, both live today and maintained by the same team that built them.
story.two: Owning products changes how we work. When you carry a system yourself you stop making decisions that look clever in a demo and cost you at two in the morning, and you learn what a shortcut costs in the second year. That experience is what our clients are actually buying.
story.three: We work in Arabic and English, right to left and left to right, with the same care given to both. Nothing here is a translated afterthought.

products.title: Products before promises
products.body: We ship our own software, so what we claim is something we have already had to live with.

engineering.title: Engineering-led delivery
engineering.body: Architecture is decided with the design, not discovered halfway through the build.

bilingual.title: Bilingual by default
bilingual.body: Arabic and English are designed together — layout, type and content in both directions.

after.title: We stay after launch
after.body: Launch is the start of the real load. We are there for it, and for what it teaches.

cta.headline: Work with us.
cta.body: Tell us what you are building and who it is for. We will tell you honestly whether we are the right team for it.

delivery.title: Service Delivery Policy
delivery.description: How CODEX TECH delivers digital products and technical services.
delivery.headline: Service Delivery Policy
delivery.intro: CODEX TECH provides digital products, software solutions, subscriptions and technical services. The company does not sell or ship any physical goods.

method.title: How delivery works
method.body: Every product and service is delivered electronically — through our digital platforms, the client account, email, or another approved digital channel.

digital.title: Digital products and subscriptions
digital.body: Digital products and subscriptions are usually activated immediately after a successful payment, or within 24 hours, depending on the service.

custom.title: Custom work
custom.body: For websites, applications, systems and other custom software, the timeline and delivery stages are agreed with the client before work begins.

confirmation.title: Confirmation
confirmation.body: The client receives confirmation by email or through the relevant platform when a service or subscription is activated.

contact.title: If you cannot access the service
contact.body: If there is any problem receiving or accessing a purchased service, write to us by email.

refunds.title: Refund and Cancellation Policy
refunds.description: When a CODEX TECH service can be cancelled and refunded.
refunds.headline: Refund and Cancellation Policy
refunds.intro: CODEX TECH aims to provide digital products and technical services that are clear and reliable.

digital.title: Digital products and subscriptions
digital.body: A client may request cancellation and a refund within 14 days of purchase, provided the digital service has not been substantially used, consumed, or customised for the client.

afterUse.title: After use or customisation
afterUse.body: After a digital service has actually been used, or after a customised service has been delivered, amounts paid may become non-refundable.

custom.title: Custom projects and services
custom.body: For software, website and mobile development and other custom work, any refund depends on the work already completed. The value of finished stages, third-party costs and work already delivered is deducted from any amount due, if a refund applies.

mistaken.title: Duplicate or mistaken payments
mistaken.body: Amounts paid in error or paid twice can be refunded after they have been verified.

payout.title: How a refund is paid
payout.body: Refunds are returned to the original payment method. The time it takes to arrive depends on the payment provider or the card-issuing bank.

contact.title: How to request a refund
contact.body: To request a cancellation or refund, write to us by email with your name, the order or transaction number, and the reason for the request.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How CODEX TECH collects, uses and protects personal data.
privacy.headline: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy covers this website. Our products — Codex Accreditation and Lammetna — process data under separate agreements with the organisations that operate them.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Only what you send us. If you use the contact form we receive your name, email address, company if you give one, and your message. We do not ask for anything else, and there is no account to create.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To answer you and to carry on the conversation you started. We do not sell your data, we do not add you to a marketing list, and we do not use it to profile you.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Enquiries are kept while the conversation is active and for a reasonable period afterwards as a business record. You can ask us to delete yours at any time.

processors.title: Who else is involved
processors.body: The site is served by our hosting provider and enquiries are delivered by an email provider. Both process the data only to deliver the service, and only for as long as that takes.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: This site does not use advertising or tracking cookies. Only the technical storage needed to remember your language and to play the opening sequence once per visit.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask what we hold about you, ask for it to be corrected, or ask for it to be deleted. Write to us and we will answer.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For anything in this policy, including deletion requests, email us.
